patches.name: Universal Captions - additional translation languages
patches.description: Adds and alphabetizes native Auto-translate languages. Caption preferences remain managed by Morphe.

release_notes:
Universal Captions 2.0.0 expands YouTube’s native Auto-translate language menu and sorts it by localized display name.

- Adds all languages supported by the patch to YouTube’s native Auto-translate menu, while retaining native entries.
- Caption preferences, source selection, visibility and Off behavior are managed by Morphe’s **Captions** patch.
- When the native Morphe additional-language feature is present, its setting controls the menu; the standalone addon leaves that behavior to Morphe.
- Older Morphe builds continue to use the independent language-menu extension.

**Upgrading from 1.4:** version 2.0 is a menu-only addon. Enable Morphe’s **Captions** patch for caption preference and visibility features. Use only one Universal Captions version in each patching session.

**Validated APK targets:** YouTube **21.20.405** and **21.41.525**. All 20 regression tests passed, and standalone and combined-native APKs passed SDK verification on both targets. The release implementation was also confirmed working on-device. Other versions remain unverified; translation availability varies by video and account.

**Install:** update this source in Morphe Manager, or import `universal-captions-2.0.0.mpp` from the assets below.

[Add source](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=itolkien%2Fmorphe-universal-captions&name=Universal%20Captions) · [Native Morphe integration (merged)](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/3754)
